hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vaults instead of standard concentrated liquidity. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a custom bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting, bypassing standard Uniswap v4 pool math.
